items.statement: The submission independently constructs and validates both the neutral singlet and radical-cation doublet of the supplied norDTCO system, preserving sulfur atoms 16 and 17.
items.expected_result: Both states are explicitly identified with charge/multiplicity and convergence or stationary-point diagnostics; S16/S17 identity is retained.

items.statement: The selected structures are validated as converged stationary points or the submission transparently reports bounded failure and diagnostics.
items.expected_result: Validation evidence is supplied for each selected state; neutral no-imaginary-frequency evidence is consistent with the source, while any method limitations are disclosed.

items.statement: The two sulfur distances and their signed oxidation-induced change are reported from the same atom pair.
items.expected_result: Neutral S–S distance is approximately 4.056 Å, radical-cation S–S distance approximately 3.983 Å, and radical-cation minus neutral change approximately −0.073 Å, subject to method/reporting uncertainty.
